coin_rule: COIN intervention science remains unauthorized until at least two independent transfer cases support the mechanisms and intervention-relevant conclusions are stable across observationally plausible models.
historical_rule: Nepal v4 remains a preserved predictive failure. v5 must face identical frozen rows and competitors once; historical outcomes may not iteratively tune the architecture.

minimal_v5_structure.battle_rule: Opposing reachable fielded armed elements remain a valid support condition for armed confrontation only, not for every organized-violence channel.
minimal_v5_structure.choice_rule: Feasibility and action choice must be separate. No new unconstrained aggression coefficient is permitted before synthetic identification.
minimal_v5_structure.observation_rule: Recording remains downstream of latent events and may not create support absent from the latent process.
minimal_v5_structure.persistent_state: Reuse existing membership, unfielded fighter-equivalent pools, fielded personnel, resources, social/political organization, information and institutions. Do not introduce a new scalar capacity stock.
minimal_v5_structure.sequence: state -> observation -> actor belief -> budget-constrained action choice -> execution -> latent event -> recorded observation

motivation: The certified v4 core restricts the empirical conflict-event support to realized contact events, while contact scheduling requires opposing effective field formations to share a microzone. Data-free counterexamples show durable organizational capacity and exposed government assets can therefore coexist with zero support for the conflict-event channel.
promotion_rule: Promote to a v5 core only after the support, choice, execution, budget, belief-boundary, and invariance tests pass without historical tuning. Then freeze v5 before any historical scoring.
proven_findings: The validation conflict_events family counts realized contact events only.
A locality with insurgent fighter-equivalent capacity and a government institution has zero contact support when no opposing effective formation is co-located.
Adding an opposing effective formation to the same microzone restores contact support.
Zero violence is compatible with both insurgent dominance and mutual organizational absence.
Transferring fighter equivalents between a local formation and the local manpower pool preserves accounted capacity while battle support can change discontinuously.
Relocation transfers fighter-equivalent capacity between localities without reproducing it.
Current directional contact initiation uses detection, availability, command, and supply feasibility; it has no distinct strategic attack-versus-wait action-selection state.
required_invariants_before_core_promotio: representative-resolution invariance within declared approximation error
relocation conservation with no reproduction credit
shared personnel/material budgets across simultaneous action channels
belief-boundary metamorphism: hidden truth changes execution but not fixed-belief planning
